program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((objs (sort (objects g 0)
                    (lambda (a b)
                      (let ((ba (obj-bbox a)) (bb (obj-bbox b)))
                        (if (= (first ba) (first bb))
                            (< (second ba) (second bb))
                            (< (first ba) (first bb))))))))
    (define (row-overlap? a b)
      (not (or (< (third a) (first b)) (< (third b) (first a)))))
    (define (col-overlap? a b)
      (not (or (< (fourth a) (second b)) (< (fourth b) (second a)))))
    (grid-from-fn (length objs) (length objs)
      (lambda (i j)
        (let* ((b1 (obj-bbox (list-ref objs i)))
               (b2 (obj-bbox (list-ref objs j)))
               (ro (row-overlap? b1 b2))
               (co (col-overlap? b1 b2)))
          (if (and ro co) 3 (if ro 1 (if co 2 0))))))))
